## Findings

Ran 8 cold-launch trials (`stopApp` → `launchApp` → tap **About** → tap **Diagnostics**) on device `<REDACTED-1>`:

| Trial | Sync status text | "Retry sync" button |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Sync idle | ✅ visible |
| 2 | Sync idle | ✅ visible |
| 3 | Sync unavailable | ❌ absent |
| 4 | Sync idle | ✅ visible |
| 5 | Sync unavailable | ❌ absent |
| 6 (with 5–8s extra settle wait) | Sync idle | ✅ visible |
| 7 | Sync idle | ✅ visible |
| 8 | Sync unavailable | ❌ absent |

**5/8 visible (62.5%)** — closely matching the reported ~3/5 pass rate.

## Root cause

The "Retry sync" button is **conditionally rendered**, not just obscured or delayed. When I pulled the full view hierarchy in the "unavailable" trials (e.g. trial 3), the button `View`/`Button`/`TextView` nodes are completely absent from the tree — only the "Sync unavailable" `TextView` is present. In the "idle" trials, that same subtree instead contains "Sync idle" plus the clickable "Retry sync" button. So the flake isn't a rendering race or animation timing issue — it's driven by which of two mutually-exclusive states the Diagnostics screen resolves to.

I ruled out the usual environmental suspects, since none of them tracked with the outcome across trials:
- **Navigation/settle timing** — adding a 5–8s explicit wait after launch before navigating (trial 6) still produced "idle," and immediate navigation (trials without extra wait) produced both outcomes.
- **Connectivity/signal icons** — status bar always showed full WiFi/mobile signal in every trial's hierarchy dump, regardless of outcome.
- **Battery/charging state** — constant ("Battery charging, 100 percent") across trials.
- **Clock/time of day (minute-level)** — no clean correlation; outcomes flipped multiple times within the same minute.
- **Persistent alternation** — the sequence (V,V,X,V,X,V,V,X) isn't a simple odd/even or launch-count alternation, which rules out a simple persisted counter surviving `stopApp`.

## Conclusion

The flake source is a **non-deterministic "sync status" check the app performs on every cold start**, independent of navigation speed or visible device/network state. On roughly 60–65% of cold launches it resolves to `Sync idle` and renders the "Retry sync" button; on the remainder it resolves to `Sync unavailable` and the button node is never composed at all. Since the UI test asserts the button is unconditionally visible, it inherits this app-level ~60% success rate directly — explaining the "passes about 3 times out of 5" symptom almost exactly.

**Recommendation for the test team:** this isn't a test-authoring bug (no need for extra waits/retries) — the app itself needs either a deterministic sync-status value for test/bench builds, or the test needs to first assert on/handle the `Sync status` text and only assert the button when it's `Sync idle` (or trigger a state that guarantees idle before asserting).
